payload.name: Controlled validation isolation
payload.statement: Controlled validation must prove declared reads, read-only protection, bounded writable roots, unreadable undeclared project paths, denied host network, immutable validation source, bounded output, and process-tree cleanup before executing a code change. Native Windows uses a pinned WSL distribution and Linux Node with bubblewrap; direct WSL/Linux uses bubblewrap directly. Missing prerequisites fail closed. Never fall back to unisolated execution or silently broaden environment, path or network access.
